title: RESOLVED (cli@1.25.0/mcp@1.31.0): MCP gate_chat WAS text-only — it now forwards the sampling fields, JSON mode and tools
summary: HISTORICAL + RESOLVED. Until 2026-06-11 the MCP gate_chat (and core.gateChat) forwarded ONLY model + messages — no temperature/max_tokens, no response_format (JSON mode), no tools/tool_choice. FIXED in @spideriq/mcp@1.31.0 / @spideriq/mcp-gate@1.3.0 / @spideriq/core@1.26.0: the inputSchema and the core method forward all of them, and spideriq gate chat exposes --json. CORRECTED 2026-10-08: that release also began forwarding spidergate_options (and the CLI flags --max-cost / --cache), and this note called those the gateway's real value. The server reads none of those fields, so forwarding them changed nothing — see 2026-10-08-spidergate-options-are-not-read. Lesson that endures: a thin wrapper that forwards only model + messages silently drops what the caller set, and unit tests pass because the basic call still works. Only token-by-token STREAMING remains HTTP-only through the single-response tool.
references: packages/mcp-tools/src/gate/gate.ts — gate_chat execute: forwards temperature, max_tokens, top_p, stop, seed, response_format, tools, tool_choice, spidergate_options
app/api/v1/gate/completions.py — _build_request_dict: the fields the server reads (spidergate_options is not one)
